calc.khilaf.label: Wurin sabani
calc.khilaf.waqs: Ƙimar ɗaya cikin arba’in kanta ittifaƙi ce; sabanin yana kan «waƙs» kawai — abin da ya wuce nisabi kafin a kai matakin gaba. Abu Hanifa yana ɗaukar abin da ya wuce a matsayin wanda aka yafe har sai ya kai kashi ɗaya cikin biyar na nisabi.
calc.khilaf.trade: Malamai sun yi sabani kan yadda za a ƙiyasta kayan — ta hanya mafi amfani ga matalauta, bisa farashin sayayya, ko da kuɗin da ake amfani da shi — da kuma kan lokacin da za a ɗauki darajar: a ƙarshen shekara, a ƙarshen biyu, ko a duk tsawonta.
calc.khilaf.jima: Mafi rinjaye sun tsaya kan tsayayyen jere da aka nuna a sama; Malikiyya sun tsaya kan zaɓi tsakanin uku kuma suna ba ciyarwa fifiko.
calc.khilaf.fidyah: Akwai sabani a asalin wajibcin bayar da fidiyya da kuma adadinta: Hanafiyya — sa’i ɗaya na dabino ko sha’ir, ko rabin sa’i na alkama; Hanabila — mudd ɗaya na alkama, ko rabin sa’i na dabino ko sha’ir.
calc.khilaf.feed: Ga kowane matalauci: mudd ɗaya bisa ra’ayin mafi rinjaye (Malikiyya, Shafi’iyya, Hanabila), da mudd biyu — rabin sa’i — bisa ra’ayin Hanafiyya. Wannan na’urar lissafi tana ɗaukar adadin mafi rinjaye a duk inda ake lissafin ciyarwa.
